facts.fact: ENA reports that the AI UniPod, inaugurated on 16 February 2026 by EAII, UNDP and Addis Ababa University, is equipped with high-performance computing resources, and UNDP's Matthias Naab said its EDGE initiative provides high-performance GPUs there.
UNDP's Matthias Naab said on 9 November 2026 that UNDP's EDGE initiative provides high-performance GPUs at the AI UniPod in Addis Ababa for innovators to build AI products.
A 10-day residency at the AI UniPod opened on 9 November 2026 for 51 AI startup founders from 12 African countries, who use the UniPod's resources, ENA reports.

systems.owner: EAII, UNDP and Addis Ababa University
